reasons.correctness: createTicket publishes SupportTicketCreatedEvent and no longer calls EmailService. The listener's onTicketCreated runs AFTER_COMMIT and sends the confirmation with all five arguments. The interface matches exactly. Build green, 3/3 acceptance, 53/53 existing.
reasons.convention_fit: Event and listener sit in support/ticket/event. The listener uses @TransactionalEventListener(phase = AFTER_COMMIT), catches and logs its own failure, and uses @RequiredArgsConstructor. The publisher is added through the existing explicit constructor. A new MockitoExtension unit test was added and run.
reasons.design_fit: Minimal footprint that reuses Spring's ApplicationEventPublisher and follows the InvoiceCreatedEvent/Listener pattern. EmailService stays in the service only because addAdminResponse still uses it. Small nit: log.warn records only e.getMessage() and drops the stack trace.
reasons.test_quality: SupportTicketCreatedEventListenerUnitTest covers the send with exact arguments and a swallowed mail failure. No unit test checks that createTicket publishes the event and no longer calls EmailService directly.
reasons.graph_use: Graph queries listed the support package and the existing *EventListener files, which led to InvoiceCreatedEventListener before editing. After that, navigation relied on failed reads, globs and greps to find paths and publisher usage.
